children: The deal adds cash management, virtual accounts and liquidity management products to Tech Mahindra’s banking technology portfolio

Tech Mahindra has acquired the cash management product suite of Finastra, comprising Fusion Cash Management, Fusion Virtual Accounts and Fusion Liquidity Management, expanding its portfolio of banking technology solutions. The financial details of the transaction have not been disclosed.

The acquisition is aimed at supporting continued product investment, innovation and business growth within Tech Mahindra’s Banking, Financial Services and Insurance (BFSI) business. It also provides for continuity of services and support for existing customers while bringing product engineering and customer success professionals into Tech Mahindra.

The acquired portfolio includes three products covering cash management, virtual accounts and liquidity management. These solutions form part of the technology infrastructure used by financial institutions to manage corporate banking and treasury-related requirements.
The addition broadens Tech Mahindra’s banking solutions portfolio as it continues to develop its offerings for the financial services sector.

Tech Mahindra intends to continue investing in the acquired products, with a focus on innovation and growth within its BFSI business. The transaction also brings experienced product engineering talent into the company, supporting the ongoing development and management of the suite.
Customer success professionals are also part of the talent transition, helping maintain support for organisations already using the products.

The acquisition includes provisions for continued services and support for existing customers. This is intended to maintain operational continuity as the products and associated teams transition to Tech Mahindra.
The financial terms of the deal and further details about the integration process have not been disclosed.

The transaction adds to Tech Mahindra’s banking technology capabilities through an established suite of cash and liquidity management products, while placing continued product investment and customer support among the stated priorities of the acquisition.
